original_failure: The k=100000 large-harmonic test at finite Hermite degree retained a spurious zero-velocity eigenvector and differed by .00383229. No agent trials were launched.
resolution: Test the stated independent rapid phase-mixing approximation by adding -Dtheta*(n*k)^2 to angular resolvents and taking Dtheta=1e6. The actual apparatus uses Dtheta=0. This tests the shortcut limit without an unresolved high-frequency velocity boundary layer. All in-domain independent-reference and convergence checks remain unchanged.
